name: Quetiapine
summary: An atypical antipsychotic that is often more sedating than people expect, and that can meaningfully affect weight and metabolism.
good: When sedation plus mood/psychosis management is specifically intended.
bad: Patients highly sensitive to metabolic burden or daytime sedation.
clinicalPearls: At low doses, sedation may dominate the clinical effect more than antipsychotic action.
mechanism: Multi-receptor antagonism including dopamine and serotonin pathways, with prominent histamine-blocking sedation at lower doses.
indications: Schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and adjunctive treatment in selected depressive or insomnia contexts.
interactionNotes: Other sedatives, alcohol, and QT-prolonging drugs can compound risk.

warnings: Sedation, orthostatic hypotension, weight gain, and metabolic effects are common practical issues.
